purpose: Texture-projection references derived from the approved Cathedral Pilgrim concept; actual model renders are produced separately by Blender.

references.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: technical orthographic character texture-projection reference for making a real 3D model in Blender.
Reference image: use ONLY the Cathedral Pilgrim in the FIRST column of the supplied concept sheet. Preserve that exact character identity, outfit, proportions and worn hand-painted PS2 texture style, not the other characters.
Create a landscape sheet of exactly TWO equally sized panels: LEFT is strict orthographic FRONT view of the pilgrim, RIGHT is strict orthographic BACK view of exactly the same pilgrim. NOT a three-quarter view. Front and back figures have identical scale and identical head-top and boot-bottom alignment. Camera horizontal, no perspective foreshortening, parallel vertical lines. Both characters centered at exactly one-quarter and three-quarters of the image width, filling about 90% of the image height. Entire body visible with generous side clearance.
Pose: neutral standing with arms straight and relaxed 12 degrees away from torso, elbows straight, closed gloved fists. Feet parallel shoulder width, legs straight, no contrapposto. Keep space between each arm and torso. NO weapons, NO shield, NO held tools, no background objects; reveal the whole body for texture projection.
Appearance: broad battered angular iron kettle helmet with wide downturned brim, dark hood, face mostly shadowed with stern mouth and chin visible. Simple corroded iron breastplate, ONE segmented angular iron pauldron on the character's anatomical LEFT shoulder (right side of front image, left side of rear image). Charcoal layered tunic, leather belt with small dull brass rectangular buckle. Brown supply pouch at anatomical right hip (left in front image) and brass flask at anatomical left hip (right in front). Ragged rust-red shoulder mantle wraps the shoulders and connects to short red cape on back ending upper thighs, with irregular torn hem. Dark baggy trousers tapering below knee, beige dirty calf wraps, scuffed leather boots, brown gloves. Preserve all these elements between front and back.
Surface style: heavily weathered low-resolution hand-painted textures as in supplied art. Scratched and pitted metal, warm rust stains and rubbed steel edges, woven fabric, hand-painted seam shadows and worn fold highlights, mud on boots and trouser knees. Sparse real modeled facets visible, deliberately PS2-era textures, not smooth plastic, not clean solid color shapes. Preserve detailed painted surface appearance from reference, not a generic simplified faceted character.
Lighting: soft neutral flat diffuse light, minimal cast shadow, no dramatic rim light, no bright specular hotspots; surfaces should be usable for texture projection. Background: perfectly uniform pale neutral gray, no gradient, no floor line or shadows. NO labels, letters, panels borders, text, watermark or extra items.

Use case: stylized-concept. Technical side-view texture-projection reference for the SAME Cathedral Pilgrim shown in supplied front/back turnaround. Preserve exact worn PS2 painted appearance, clothing, proportions, rusted kettle helmet, dark hood, ONE left shoulder metal pauldron, red shoulder mantle and upper-thigh-length torn back cape, fitted rusted breastplate, leather belt, pouch on anatomical right, brass flask on anatomical left, charcoal tunic and baggy trousers, beige calf wraps, leather boots and gloves. Same character identity, no redesign.
Create exactly TWO equal-width panels in a landscape image, full body, both same size and head/feet aligned.
LEFT PANEL: STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC LEFT-SIDE PROFILE, camera on character's anatomical LEFT, the armored shoulder is visible. The face and toes point toward the LEFT edge of the image. No visible front of chest or rear of back: exact side elevation.
RIGHT PANEL: STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC RIGHT-SIDE PROFILE, camera on character's anatomical RIGHT, the unarmored cloth shoulder is visible. Face and toes point toward the RIGHT edge of image. Exact side elevation.
Full human body in each panel centered around x=25% and x=75%. Head top around 3% image height, feet bottom around 97%. Natural anatomically plausible depth, chest/abdomen/helmet balanced around the vertical center of each panel. Neutral straight standing pose, arms hanging straight down slightly away from torso as in reference, no bent elbows or action pose. Hands empty, no shield, no sword, no held weapons. Arms in side projection overlap body naturally. NO three-quarter views, NO perspective, no environment.
Retain the reference's actual painted detail: pitted rusty iron with rubbed edges, dirty woven cloth with seams and fold highlights, worn leather, muddy boots and wraps. NO clean flat-color plastic surfaces, no photorealistic reinterpretation.
Soft flat neutral diffuse lighting suitable for texture projection, no dramatic lighting, no floor shadows. Uniform pale neutral gray background. No text, labels, lines, panel dividers or watermarks.
